mapper.sql: e.ESTIMATES_ID, e.REPAIR_NO, e.FIXER_ID, e.ESTIMATES_PRICE, e.ESTIMATES_STATUS, e.EST_DURATION, e.EST_MESSAGE, TO_CHAR(e.ESTIMATES_PROPOSED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PROPOSED_AT_TEXT, TO_CHAR(e.ACCEPTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ACCEPTED_AT_TEXT, r.RECEIPT_CODE, r.RECEIPT_TITLE, r.RECEIPT_STATUS, c.CATEGORY_ITEM, u.USER_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ESTIMATES e JOIN REPAIR_REQUESTS r ON r.REPAIR_NO = e.REPAIR_NO JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = r.CATEGORY_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = r.USER_ID WHERE e.REPAIR_NO = #{repairNo} AND e.FIXER_ID = #{fixerId}

SELECT FROM ESTIMATES e JOIN REPAIR_REQUESTS r ON r.REPAIR_NO = e.REPAIR_NO JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = r.CATEGORY_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = r.USER_ID WHERE e.ESTIMATES_ID = #{estimatesId} AND e.FIXER_ID = #{fixerId}

SELECT FROM ESTIMATES e JOIN REPAIR_REQUESTS r ON r.REPAIR_NO = e.REPAIR_NO JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = r.CATEGORY_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = r.USER_ID WHERE e.FIXER_ID = #{fixerId} ORDER BY e.ESTIMATES_PROPOSED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ESTIMATES SET ESTIMATES_PRICE = #{estimatesPrice}, EST_DURATION = #{estDuration}, EST_MESSAGE = #{estMessage}, ESTIMATES_PROPOSED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ESTIMATES_ID = #{estimatesId} AND ESTIMATES_STATUS = 'PROPOSED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ESTIMATES_OPTION (OPTION_ID, ESTIMATES_ID, OPTION_CODE) VALUES (SEQ_ESTIMATES_OPTION.NEXTVAL, #{estimatesId}, #{optionCode})
